title: Lunches with Mirtha Legrand
text: In 1968 Mirtha Legrand began inviting guests to lunch on television. More than half a century later she was still at the table.

title: Leonardo Favio
text: In 1968 the film director Leonardo Favio turned singer, and “Fuiste mía un verano” was heard all over Latin America.
